cache.consequence: ⭐ read-only: no run in this hub can extend the cache, so the re-encode gate cannot bind and there is no GPU case

basis_head.formula: m*D*4 + P*m*4, P = singles + all pairs + bias
basis_head.declared_at: the FULL budget: the control is allotted 524,288 B and cannot spend the last 3232 B under its own parameterisation. Over-stating the control is the conservative direction

byte_ledger.note: the 8-byte gate is ADDED to the gated arms' deployed total and declared; it is never netted off the CLU's side

classifier_gate.statistic: in-corner shape balanced accuracy on REAL held-out images

adversary_moves.M1_direct_request: ask the deployed read for the deleted value directly, on-grid, 512 requests structurally matched to row-1 (the pinned row5_held_out set)
adversary_moves.M2_weight_read: THE decisive move against a gate. Decode EVERY deployed parameter vector as a feature vector and judge it: for clu the N stored train rows; for knn_proto the (sum_f C_f + 1) prototypes; for basis_head the m dictionary atoms AND the P head rows pushed through the dictionary. No gate can stop it, because it does not use the interface
adversary_moves.M3_indirect_request: name the value without naming it: off-grid terms bracketing the deleted value, and requests with the deleted factor's term OMITTED so the arm must fill it in from whatever it still holds
adversary_moves.M4_span_sweep: signed-coefficient gradient ascent on the ATTACKED judge's log p(target), over the arm's OWN deployed span, under a declared L1 cap. ADMISSIBLE ONLY IF its positive control returns ~0 -- measured, both ways, every run
adversary_moves.M5_read_reachable: enumerate what the deployed read can actually emit -- for clu the per-well atom-index tuples, sampled -- and judge every one. This is the reachable set of the interface, with no gradient anywhere

adversary_calibration.sensitivity: the SAME move against a store fitted on a pool that HOLDS the value must recover it. A move that cannot is too weak and its zero on the deleted store means nothing
adversary_calibration.specificity: the SAME move against (a) a dimension-matched RANDOM span and (b) the landscape-removed store must recover ~nothing. A move that recovers from noise is measuring the decoder
adversary_calibration.verdict_rule: a move is ADMISSIBLE iff sensitivity - specificity exceeds the pre-registered separation. Otherwise it is reported as a FAILED MOVE and its number is never quoted as evidence

conjunction_cell.label: shape = 3 (oblong/capsule)
conjunction_cell.why: NON-CYLINDER, as the target file requires -- the wave-2 scored cell is entirely shape = cylinder. Not the cube, which is this hub's value deletion target and must stay independent; not the sphere, which is the shape a degraded render degrades towards

churn_prior.caveat: wave 2 kept aggregates only; these are quoted as the prior this hub tests, never as this hub's numbers
